# Synthetic SMART snapshot

Hand-authored 2026-09-24, schema v1; no real device output or serial is present. The matching smartctl-shaped ATA/NVMe/SCSI fixtures are under `collector/testdata/smart`. These establish parser and storage semantics, not hardware compatibility. The installed smartctl version, by-id paths, permission model, USB/HBA behavior, standby response and actual temperatures remain live gates.
